entries.title: AetherHeart (以太之心)
entries.subtitle: Agent Researcher — Fracture
bullets: Study capability gaps between frontier systems and 8B–27B edge models across 6 task categories and 16 benchmarks, with trace-level error analysis and cost-aware evaluation.
Build reproducible baselines for Qwen3-8B, Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-120B, Kimi K3, and DeepSeek v4 Pro; record sample-level JSONL traces, token usage, latency, scores, and random seeds.
Compare few-shot, SkillOpt, LoRA-based SFT, GRPO, and TTT-Discover under frozen splits, multiple seeds, checkpoint recovery, and task-specific evaluators.

entries.title: Adversarial Agent Arena — Heuristic vs. RL Agents in Games
entries.subtitle: Project Contributor
bullets: Contribute to a game-agnostic benchmark comparing Agent Heuristic Learning and reinforcement-learning agents with fixed seeds, role-swapped matches, replayable traces, win-rate, and Elo reporting.

Integrate Slime Volleyball as a headless calibration environment with 12-dimensional observations and 8 legal joint actions; isolate policy processes and validate deterministic baseline/random matches.
